description: This source file defines the ProductType entity class for the Shopizer e-commerce platform, representing product classification data including id, code, and add-to-cart permission, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ProductType
classes.description: Entity class representing a product type, with fields for id, code, add-to-cart flag, and audit information, mapped to the PRODUCT_TYPE database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product type.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit section data for the product type.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section data for the product type.

methods.name: isAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Checks if the product type permits adding to cart.

methods.name: setAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Sets whether adding to cart is allowed for this product type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the product type.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the product type.
